page.privacy.title: Privacy — YourMiniTools
page.privacy.metaDescription: YourMiniTools privacy policy: cookies, Google AdSense advertising, data processing and GDPR consent.
page.privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
page.privacy.personalData.title: Personal Data
page.privacy.personalData.text: YourMiniTools does not collect personal data. No registration, login, or identifying information is required to use the tools.
page.privacy.cookies.title: Cookies
page.privacy.cookies.text: This site does not set its own tracking, analytics, or profiling cookies. Two localStorage keys are used for technical operation:
page.privacy.cookies.cloudflare: Cloudflare hosting infrastructure may set its own technical cookies (e.g. {cookie}). This cannot be excluded completely.
page.privacy.processing.title: Data Processing
page.privacy.processing.text: All main processing happens locally in the browser. Files uploaded by the user (images, text) are not sent to the project's servers.
page.privacy.external.title: External Connections
page.privacy.external.text: The only connection to external services occurs in the Currency Converter (Tool 12), which queries the {frankfurter} for ECB reference exchange rates. No personal user data is transmitted in this request.
page.privacy.advertising.title: Advertising
page.privacy.advertising.text: This site uses Google AdSense to display advertisements. Google and its partners use cookies and similar technologies to serve and personalize ads based on your previous visits to this and other websites. For users in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, a consent request is shown through a Google-certified Consent Management Platform before personalized ads are served, in compliance with the GDPR.
page.privacy.advertising.optout: You can manage ad personalization in {adsSettings} and read how Google uses data from sites that use its services in {googlePolicy}.
page.privacy.hosting.title: Hosting
page.privacy.hosting.text: The site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. As part of the hosting infrastructure, Cloudflare may collect anonymized access logs (with anonymized IP).
page.privacy.analytics.title: Analytics
page.privacy.analytics.text: Currently no analytics systems are active. If Cloudflare Web Analytics is activated in the future, it will be a privacy-first service that does not use tracking cookies and is GDPR compliant. This page will be updated accordingly.
page.privacy.contact.title: Contact
page.privacy.contact.text: For privacy questions you can contact us through the {aboutLink} page.
page.about.title: About — YourMiniTools
page.about.metaDescription: YourMiniTools: 12 free, fast, privacy-first micro-tools. Discover the project and philosophy behind the site.
page.about.ogDescription: Discover the YourMiniTools project and philosophy.
page.about.heading: About
page.about.project.title: The Project
page.about.project.text: YourMiniTools is a suite of 12 free micro-tools designed to be fast, simple, and privacy-respecting. Every tool runs directly in the browser, without registration and without sending your data to our servers.
page.about.philosophy.title: Philosophy
page.about.philosophy.intro: We believe online tools should be accessible to everyone, without barriers. That's why YourMiniTools is:
page.about.philosophy.free: {label} — no paid plans, no locked features.
page.about.philosophy.privacy: {label} — local browser processing; ads served by Google only with your consent.
page.about.philosophy.transparent: {label} — stated technical limitations, no unrealistic promises.
page.about.tech.title: Technology
page.about.tech.text: The site is built with pure HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no frameworks. It is hosted on Cloudflare Pages for global speed and high expected reliability. The only two external libraries used are {qrcode} for QR generation and {jspdf} for PDF export, both hosted locally.
page.about.limits.title: Stated Limitations
page.about.limits.browsers: Compatible with modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari from the last 2 years).
page.about.limits.performance: Variable performance on very old devices or those with limited RAM.
page.about.limits.images: Limits on large image files (size and resolution).
page.about.limits.rates: Exchange rate accuracy depends on the availability of the external provider (Frankfurter API / ECB).
